title: SEO & Local SEO
excerpt: Help the right people find your business, wherever they’re searching.
content:
Be easier to discover.

Your next customer may already be looking for what you offer. We help you connect your website and local presence to the searches that matter to your business.

Whether you serve a neighborhood or a wider audience, we start with your goals, your current visibility and the people you want to reach. Then we shape a practical plan for improving your search presence.
packageDetails:
Depending on your needs, our work can include a website search review, page structure and content recommendations, keyword mapping, and improvements to your Google Business Profile and local business information.

We agree on priorities and the scope of work before starting. Search results develop over time; rankings and traffic are not guaranteed.
process:
1. Tell us about your business, website and target locations.
  2. We discuss your goals and review the search areas that need attention.
  3. You receive a proposed scope and quote before work begins.

title: Website Design & Development
excerpt: A thoughtful digital home for your business, designed around the people who use it.
content:
Make a strong first impression. Make the next step easy.

Your website should explain what you do, feel like your brand and help visitors take action. We bring design and development together to create a clear, useful experience across phones, tablets and larger screens.

From a focused landing page to a business website or online store, we work with you to turn your ideas into a site with a purpose.
packageDetails:
We can help with page planning, responsive interface design, website development, contact forms and the integrations your site needs. For e-commerce projects, we discuss your catalog, checkout requirements and the tools you already use.

Your proposal sets out the pages, features, content responsibilities and launch support included. Hosting, third-party subscriptions and ongoing maintenance are discussed separately.
process:
1. Share your business goals, existing website and the kind of site you have in mind.
  2. We define the pages, functionality and design direction together.
  3. We prepare a tailored quote and delivery plan for your review.

title: AI Automation & Chatbot Setup
excerpt: Give repetitive tasks a better system, and give your team more room to focus.
content:
Less repetition. More time for meaningful work.

Good automation starts with understanding how your business works. We help you identify useful opportunities for chatbots and connected workflows, then build around the tools and processes you rely on.

From answering common questions to organizing incoming leads, the aim is a system that supports your team and keeps a clear path to human help.
packageDetails:
Possible projects include a chatbot grounded in your approved business content, lead capture and routing, CRM updates, and follow-up workflows. We define what can be automated, where human review is needed, and how exceptions should be handled.

Platform subscriptions and usage charges are outlined separately. Email and SMS workflows are scoped around your approved contacts and communication preferences.
process:
1. Tell us which tasks take up your time and which tools you currently use.
  2. We map a focused workflow and agree on the information it needs.
  3. You receive a setup proposal covering integrations, testing and handover.

title: Digital Advertising Management
excerpt: Reach people with intention through campaigns connected to your business goals.
content:
Put your message in the right places.

Effective advertising takes more than launching an ad. It needs a clear offer, a relevant audience and a useful next step. We help plan and manage campaigns around what you want your business to achieve.

Whether you want to introduce your brand, attract inquiries or reconnect with interested visitors, we work with you on a campaign approach that fits your goals and budget.
packageDetails:
Our agreed scope can include campaign planning, account setup or review, audience and keyword research, ad coordination, conversion tracking and ongoing adjustments.

Media spend is separate from management fees. We agree on the budget, reporting and responsibilities in advance; advertising performance and sales are not guaranteed.
process:
1. Share your offer, audience, current campaigns and intended budget.
  2. We review the channels and measurement needed for your goals.
  3. We prepare a campaign scope and management quote for your approval.

title: Business & LLC Launch Services
excerpt: Get organized for your next venture, from the first setup steps to your online presence.
content:
Give your business a considered beginning.

Starting a business comes with a lot of moving parts. We help you organize the practical setup tasks, understand the information you need and build a digital foundation for your new venture.

Bring your idea and your questions. We’ll work with you to identify the support that fits your stage of the journey.
packageDetails:
Support can include organizing information for formation steps, guidance on the EIN application process, a startup checklist, and setting up a domain and business email.

The scope depends on your location and business needs. Government filing fees, domain registration and email subscriptions are separate from service fees. This is administrative and technical support; legal and tax advice should come from a qualified professional.
process:
1. Tell us about your business idea, location and what you have already completed.
  2. We identify the setup tasks and digital tools you need help with.
  3. You receive a clear outline of our assistance and a quote before we start.
